show.description:
After Amit Mehra’s death, his pregnant widow Shalini becomes the prime target in a brutal underworld rivalry.
Amit’s volatile younger brother Rohan takes control of the empire, torn between protecting Shalini and battling his own rising feelings for her.
As betrayals escalate and enemies close in, Rohan and Shalini must fight side-by-side to save the Mehra dynasty and their forbidden bond. Watch now.
